response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional capabilities in large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and technical mentoring, he falls short of a critical minimum qualification: 8 years of C++ programming experience. His documented C++ experience is approximately 6 months at National Instruments plus academic work—far below the requirement. For a technical lead role on a cloud compute platform (which likely relies heavily on C++), this expertise gap poses a credibility and decision-making risk. His strengths in other areas do not fully compensate for the absence of deep C++ mastery in this specialized role.
strengths: Extensive experience architecting and managing large-scale distributed systems and microservices infrastructure (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby, Kubernetes deployments)
Proven technical leadership and mentoring capabilities demonstrated through teaching workshops, open-source contributions, and multiple senior/staff engineering roles
Strong software design, architecture, and engineering best practices expertise (TDD, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code with AWS CDK and Docker)
concerns: Critical gap: only ~6 months documented C++ experience versus 8 years minimum required; C++ notably absent from skills section
Background primarily in full-stack product engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than specialized cloud compute platform technical leadership
No demonstrated experience specifically mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers in production environments
